reasons: Both seven-slide outputs correctly explain local pressure summation, timing/path dependence, passive versus active isolation, and partially attenuated but audible speech without inventing measured performance.

A is stronger at keeping the model and historical-evidence qualifications visible. B gives a more immediate rumble-to-low-frequency bridge, a useful normalized-period illustration and a clearer serial speech-residual explanation.

Neither dominates overall: A has two native-object identity collisions and some novice terminology gaps; B has qualifications that remain in notes and the same undefined occlusion term. These are bounded revisions, not evidence that either core explanation is unusable.
Binary expectation totals are deliberately not overall quality scores. No runtime-success advantage, arbitrary aesthetic score or object-count reward was assigned.

scope.method: Individually viewed every actual supplied PowerPoint-exported PNG at full size, without re-rendering. Compared visible claims and all extracted speaker notes with frozen research; inspected native object types, native table cell data and band geometry. Review-owned PowerShell only parsed supplied data and ZIP XML; no artifact code was executed. Decks and sources were not modified.
scope.interpretation: A/B are anonymous random labels. This technical-repair stage is not untouched first-pass compatibility. Application edits were programmatic, not human usability evidence.

A.observation: Readable question, two experience cards and visible '仍听得见 ≠ 完全没减弱'; opening bridge says '一些成分较易主动控制' without yet naming lower frequency.
Two distinguishable sound routes meet at the ear target. Sum, amplitude/phase condition and small-signal/locality caveat are all visible; arrows do not obscure text.
Native table values 100/1000 赫兹, 100/1000 次, 3.6°/36° are readable. Hypothetical 0.10 毫秒 and single-tone linear scope are explicit.
Comparison table is legible. '关 ANC ≠ 摘下耳机' and nonabsolute frequency tendency remain visible. Bottom caveat wraps to a short final line without clipping.
Branching speech-component diagram leads to audible residual. Counterexample limitation is visible, but '低频闭塞增强' is unexplained. Relative-salience condition says '轰鸣减得更多时'.
Three readable sections distinguish modes, fit and controlled comparison. Historical prototype/partial-reading caveat is visible.
Readable synthesis of summation, matching and residual; visible personal-prediction limit and source/product scope. No obscured essential text observed.

B.observation: Readable two-card comparison directly names persistent lower-frequency rumble components and partially weakened but audible speech.
Readable routes to ear-target summation and propagation-after-alignment warning. Visible ideal single-tone condition, but small-signal and microphone/eardrum caveats are notes-only.
Two normalized-period bands visibly encode different fractions with 3.6° and 36° labels. Hypothesis/no-measurement/no-cutoff warnings are readable; steady single-tone linear scope is notes-only.
Readable active/passive cards and ANC-off baseline distinction. Frequency tendency and fit caveat are retained.
Clear three-step speech-to-control-to-residual flow. Own-voice limitation visible, but unfamiliar occlusion term unexplained. '轰鸣减少后' drops the stronger comparative wording found in notes.
Modes and fit are separated, with '行为依产品而定' visible. Fixed-fit/source comparison instruction is legible.
Readable synthesis and contrasting scope card; declines both personal dB and intelligibility predictions, gives missing inputs and partial-source-reading limitation.

blocking_major_assessment: No blocking or major content/rendering defect was established in either output after inspecting all fourteen slides. The native ID collisions below are real structural defects but are classified minor because the supplied PowerPoint export and limited edit probes succeeded; no corrupted slide or failed edit is demonstrated. This is not a guarantee against untested interoperability problems.

actionable_defects.label: both

actionable_defects.impact: A correct counterexample is harder to understand than the main residual explanation. This is a reviewer assessment, not a measured comprehension failure.
